categories.title: Features / 功能
list: Initial stable release / 首个稳定版本
Import Minecraft-style OBJ building exports as Blockbench Java cubes / 将 Minecraft 风格建筑 OBJ 导入为 Blockbench Java 方块
Read MTL files and load linked PNG textures for preview / 读取 MTL 文件并加载关联 PNG 贴图用于预览
Add imported cubes to the current project when a project is open / 当前已有项目时，把导入方块加入当前项目
Create a Java Block project automatically when no project is open / 当前没有项目时，可自动创建 Java Block 项目
Save and reopen plugin import settings / 保存并复用插件导入设置
Apply texture namespace, texture folder, texture size, and cullface settings to imported content / 将贴图命名空间、贴图文件夹、贴图尺寸和 cullface 设置应用到已导入内容
Export imported OBJ textures into a resource pack folder / 将导入的 OBJ 贴图导出到资源包目录
Patch Java model texture paths with explicit namespaces during export / 导出 Java 模型时自动补全带命名空间的贴图路径

categories.title: Safety / 安全提示
list: Warn when generated model coordinates exceed the common Java Block/Item coordinate range / 当生成坐标超出 Java Block/Item 常见范围时给出提示
Warn when an import is expected to create more than 5,000 cubes / 当预计生成超过 5,000 个方块时提示性能风险
Show a stronger warning for imports expected to create 10,000 or more cubes / 当预计生成 10,000 个或更多方块时给出更强提醒
